tagline: Biometric attendance with face matching and OWL kiosk
problem: Manual attendance and shared PINs create buddy punching and payroll disputes.
solution: Attendance Face Recognition stores face embeddings, matches employees at kiosk check-in, and writes clean HR attendance records.

features.title: Face Embeddings
features.text: Store vectors, not raw photos, for privacy-aware matching.

features.title: OWL Kiosk
features.text: Dedicated check-in UI for reception and shop floor.

features.title: Recognition Logs
features.text: Audit trail for matches, failures, and devices.

features.title: Engine Adapters
features.text: Swap OpenCV, InsightFace, or ONNX without HR changes.

seo_keywords: Odoo attendance, face recognition, biometric kiosk, HR attendance Odoo 20
